name: Plex Media Server
description: Organizes your movies, TV shows and music and streams them to Plex apps on TVs, phones and browsers. Official Plex image with the server built in (pinned version).

volumes.name: config
volumes.description: Plex database, metadata and settings (can grow to many GB). Must be a Docker volume: the database needs file locking that Windows folders do not provide.

volumes.name: media
volumes.description: Your media library (movies, TV, music), read-only.

inputs.label: Media folder
inputs.help: The folder that holds your Movies, TV Shows and Music folders (e.g. D:\Media). Mounted read-only; Plex never changes your files.

inputs.label: Claim token (optional)
inputs.help: From https://www.plex.tv/claim/ (valid for a few minutes). Links the server to your Plex account on first start; without it, finish setup from this PC at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/web.

inputs.label: Direct access from your network (port 32400 on this PC)
inputs.help: TVs and phones at home connect directly instead of through plex.tv relays.

inputs.label: Address to advertise (optional)
inputs.help: e.g. http://192.168.1.20:32400/ so apps find the server on your network.

inputs.label: Networks allowed without sign-in (optional)
inputs.help: CIDR list, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Leave empty to always require a Plex account.

inputs.label: NVIDIA GPU transcoding (Plex Pass)
inputs.help: Passes the NVIDIA GPU through WSL2. Not verified on this PC; Intel Quick Sync is not available on Docker Desktop.

privileges.explain: Only when NVIDIA GPU transcoding is chosen: the container gets access to the GPU through Docker Desktop's WSL2 GPU support.

security: Your media folder is mounted read-only.
Remote access through plex.tv is a setting inside Plex; installing publishes nothing to the Internet.

notes: Plex apps and TVs sign in with plex.tv accounts and tokens; ForwardAuth and Cloudflare Access break them. Use direct local access and Plex's own remote access instead of a sign-in gate.

limitations: Plex does not recommend Docker on Windows; this keeps its database in a Docker volume inside WSL2, which avoids the file-locking problem.
Local discovery (GDM, DLNA) needs multicast, which Docker Desktop does not pass: apps may need the server address entered or found through plex.tv.
Intel Quick Sync (/dev/dri) is not available on Docker Desktop; NVIDIA transcoding through WSL2 is untested here.
Media on another Windows drive is read through Docker Desktop's file sharing: scans are slower than on Linux.
manualSetup: Get a claim token at https://www.plex.tv/claim/ right before installing, or finish setup at http://127.0.0.1:<local port>/web from this PC.
In Plex, add libraries pointing at /data/<folder> (e.g. /data/Movies).
An existing Plex installation is detected and offered for adoption instead; its libraries and metadata are never changed.

update.notes: Pinned server version: the image does not download a newer server at start. Updates back up the config volume first (it can be large).

testStatus.notes: Installed in isolation: health, own API, network isolation, modular stack, stop/start, Traefik file route, backup and restore, removal with data.
